desc: Thiollier met St. Trina once, slept the sweetest sleep of his life, and has spent every day since trying to get back to it. He sells poisons at a roadside cross in the Gravesite Plain and follows Miquella only because Miquella is the other half of the girl he is chasing. His quest is a long walk to the bottom of the Stone Coffin Fissure and a lot of deliberate deaths at St. Trina's hands, and finishing it gives you the second gold summon for the final boss alongside Sir Ansbach. Run Moore's questline before you tell Thiollier where St. Trina is, because Thiollier leaving his cross ends Moore's errand.
whatItIs: A poison-seller camped at a cross in the Gravesite Plain, Thiollier has chased the memory of one perfect night's sleep ever since St. Trina granted it to him. The quest sends you down the Stone Coffin Fissure to the Garden of Deep Purple, where repeated sips of her nectar and the relaying of her words to him form the whole thread.
whyItMatters: Completing the line yields Thiollier's Hidden Needle, St. Trina's Smile, St. Trina's Blossom, his full armor set, and a gold summon sign for the Promised Consort Radahn fight. Telling Thiollier about St. Trina before Moore's Black Syrup errand finishes at Main Gate Cross ends both lines, since that sends him off the cross permanently.
whenToUse: The Shadow of the Erdtree expansion is needed before this one can start. Meet Thiollier at Pillar Path Cross in the Gravesite Plain, finish the Black Syrup delivery to Moore at Main Gate Cross before telling him where St. Trina is, and complete the nectar and dialogue steps in the Garden of Deep Purple before Shadow Keep or Enir-Ilim opens.
name: St. Trina and Thiollier's questline

steps.text: Ride southeast from the Castle Front grace to Pillar Path Cross and speak to Thiollier, who is sitting beside it. Exhaust him until his shop opens.
Buy anything from Moore at Main Gate Cross so the "Talk to Moore" option appears, then tell him about Thiollier. Moore gives you the Black Syrup to deliver.

lockouts.name: Shadow Keep
lockouts.note: Moore stops handing out the Black Syrup

steps.text: Take the Black Syrup back to Thiollier, choose to ask about it, and tell him you are weary of life. He gives you a Thiollier's Concoction and adds it to his stock.

lockouts.name: Shadow Keep
lockouts.note: the same errand

steps.text: Take the north road to the keep gates and let the rune-break message fire. Nothing Thiollier says changes before that moment.
Go back to Pillar Path Cross. If he says he has something he wishes to tell you, he is about to leave, so buy the Deadly Poison Perfume Bottle and any spare Concoctions now, then reload the area.

lockouts.name: his move to the Garden of Deep Purple
lockouts.note: his entire shop stock

steps.text: Follow the Ellac River down to the Cerulean Coast and ride to the crater at its southern tip. Work down the ledges on the west side of the pit and take the tunnel at the bottom into the Stone Coffin Fissure.

Push through the fissure to the Fissure Depths grace, then drop off the end of the path into the dark below to land in the Putrescent Knight's arena. Thiollier leaves a gold sign to your right as you land.

lockouts.name: Putrescent Knight
lockouts.note: his cooperator sign for that fight

steps.text: Beyond the arena is the Garden of Deep Purple grace, with St. Trina asleep in the flowers and Thiollier standing over her.

Interact with St. Trina and choose to imbibe her nectar. It kills you every time. Do it four times in total; Thiollier begs for more poison out loud after the third death, and on the fourth she speaks to you across the death screen.
Speak to Thiollier and pass on St. Trina's words. He refuses to believe you, so talk again and try a second time until he is properly furious.
Fast travel to the Garden of Deep Purple grace and walk back toward the garden. Thiollier invades; kill him and he drops St. Trina's Smile.

Enter the garden again and you will find him lying on the ground. Exhaust him until he asks what St. Trina told you. If he is missing, rest and come back; he is there at the latest once the Sealing Tree has burned.

Imbibe the nectar twice more to hear her last two messages - that godhood would be a prison, and that Miquella must be killed and forgiven - then pass them on to him one final time. His answer is a long, broken laugh, and that sound is how you know the quest is finished.

lockouts.name: Enir-Ilim
lockouts.note: the last conversation, and both of his gold summon signs

steps.text: In the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom, call Thiollier in on his gold sign, along with Ansbach if you have him, and only then answer the red sign that starts the brawl.
His gold sign appears again outside the final arena. Summon him against Promised Consort Radahn; afterwards his body carries Thiollier's Hidden Needle and his whole outfit.
With Promised Consort Radahn dead, go back down to the garden. St. Trina's flower has withered, and St. Trina's Blossom lies at its foot.

desc: Joining Volcano Manor does not only put you on Tanith's payroll. Two of the guests in the eastern quarter run contracts of their own, and each hands you an extra red sign to answer once you have finished one of hers. These are easy to walk past because nobody tells you they exist: Patches wants a bull-horned knight dead, Bernahl wants two old Roundtable champions dead, and between them they are worth a weapon, a sorcery and two full armour sets. Every one of them dies with Rykard, so run the whole board before you go down to the serpent.
whatItIs: The Volcano Manor Recusants include two guests in the eastern quarter who run contracts of their own: Patches wants a bull-horned knight dead, and Bernahl wants two old Roundtable champions dead. Between them they hand out a weapon, a sorcery, and two full armour sets, and nobody tells the character they exist, so they are easy to walk past.
whyItMatters: The rewards are the Magma Whip Candlestick, Gelmir's Fury, the Bull-Goat armour set, the Raging Wolf armour set, and the Recusant Finger. Defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy before collecting the Letter to Bernahl loses the Raging Wolf set for the run, and any invasion sign that had not yet appeared never will. The Magma Whip Candlestick only comes out of the second conversation with Patches after reporting Great Horned Tragoth's death, so a single talk is not enough.
whenToUse: Join the manor first and collect the Drawing-Room Key from Tanith, because that key opens the eastern quarter where Patches and Bernahl stand. Complete Tanith's first contract against Old Knight Istvan before Patches offers his letter, and complete the second against Rileigh the Idle before Bernahl hands over his. Take Tanith's "See the Lord" option only when both side contracts are finished, because that fight ends every remaining contract at once.
name: The Volcano Manor side contracts

steps.text: Join the manor first. Tanith's Drawing-Room Key is what opens the eastern quarter where all of these people stand, so nothing here is reachable until you have agreed to become family.

lockouts.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
lockouts.note: nothing on this page can be started

steps.text: Take the Recusant Finger off the drawing-room table on your first visit. It is a reusable invasion item, so unlike the Bloody Fingers it is never consumed.

lockouts.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
lockouts.note: the finger is left behind with the rest of the room's contents

steps.text: Walk the eastern quarter and introduce yourself to everyone before you take any contract, because the manor is where Patches, Bernahl, Rya and Diallos all park themselves for this stretch of the game.
Complete Tanith's first contract against Old Knight Istvan, then speak to Patches; with Istvan dead he offers you the Letter to Patches naming Great Horned Tragoth.

lockouts.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
lockouts.note: the letter never appears

steps.text: Follow the red mark to the Ruin-Strewn Precipice and use the invasion sign inside the Magma Wyrm Makar arena; Tragoth is a slow, enormously poised Bull-Goat knight, so fight him with rolls rather than trades.
Loot the Bull-Goat set from his corpse. It is the heaviest armour in the game and one of the two highest-poise sets, which is exactly what a trade-happy hyper-armour build wants.
Report back to Patches, then talk to him a second time; the Magma Whip Candlestick only comes out on the second conversation.

lockouts.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
lockouts.note: Patches leaves the manor and the reward is gone

steps.text: Complete Tanith's second contract against Rileigh the Idle, then speak to Bernahl in the eastern quarter; he hands over the Letter to Bernahl, which names two targets at once.

lockouts.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
lockouts.note: the letter never appears

steps.text: Ride to the ground floor of the Fortified Manor in Leyndell and use the sign there. You are dropped into a two-on-one against Vargram the Raging Wolf and Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, but Bernahl comes in with you.
Deal with Wilhelm first if you can reach him, because his Stars of Ruin and Night Comet punish you the whole time Vargram is holding you in melee with a Godslayer's Greatsword.
Collect the Raging Wolf set from the field once both are down; it is the far lighter counterpart to the Bull-Goat armour you just took off Tragoth.
Return to Bernahl at the manor and he pays with Gelmir's Fury, a sorcery that tears a sheet of magma up out of the ground.

lockouts.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
lockouts.note: Bernahl only drops the spell much later, when he invades you in Crumbling Farum Azula
